payload.title: Docs concepts page links to /documentation/basics/* and evaluation-metrics, which return 404
payload.description:
**Problem**
https://primus.anth.us/documentation/concepts links to pages that do not exist.

**Evidence** (HTTP status on 2026-10-20)
- /documentation/basics/items 404, /documentation/basics/sources 404, /documentation/basics/scores 404, /documentation/basics/scorecards 404, /documentation/basics/tasks 404
- /documentation/concepts/evaluation-metrics 404, /documentation/basics 404
- /documentation/basics/evaluations now returns 200 (the audit saw 404; recheck).

**Fix**
Point each link at the page that exists (most concept pages live under /documentation/concepts/*), or create the missing pages.

**How to verify**
Crawl https://primus.anth.us/documentation/concepts and confirm every internal link returns 200, for example with `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' <url>` on each.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
